notes.title: 🌟🎮 THE INDIE HOUSES STEAM EVENT: CELEBRATING WOMEN IN GAMING! 🎮🌟
notes.notes:
Join us from [u][b]May 25-31[/b][/u] for an exciting weeklong celebration of women in gaming as [url=https://theindiehouses.org/][b]The Indie Houses[/b][/url] proudly presents the Women in Gaming Steam Event, in collaboration with [url=https://www.gmgsf.org/]Girls Make Games[/url]. This event aims to support the Girls Make Games Scholarship Fund and empower the next generation of game creators.

We are thrilled to announce that we are collaborating alongside some incredible partners.
Together with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/akuparagames]Akupara Games[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/fellowtraveller?snr=1_7_15__13]Fellow Traveller[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/togeproductions?snr=1_7_15__13]Toge Productions[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/whitethorngames?snr=1_7_15__13]Whithethorn Games[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rawfury?snr=1_7_15__13]Raw Fury[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/thoseawesomeguys?snr=1_7_15__13]Those Awesome Guys[/url], we are determined to make a lasting impact.

During this event, we will showcase over 60 incredible games that feature women-led development teams and/or female protagonists. Prepare to immerse yourself in captivating experiences from studios such as [i]Kaigan Games[/i], creators of the acclaimed [i]SIMULACRA [/i]series; [i]Keybol Games[/i], the brilliant minds behind [i]Jack Axe[/i]; and [i]GameChanger Studio[/i], the masterminds behind the hauntingly beautiful [i]My Lovely Wife[/i] and [i]My Lovely Daughter[/i].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/985780/Jack_Axe?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100703
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011190/SIMULACRA_2?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100703
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925970/SIMULACRA_3?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100703
https://store.steampowered.com/app/580170/My_Lovely_Daughter?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100704
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251930/My_Lovely_Wife?snr=1_614_615_theindiehouses2023_100704


Throughout the event, you'll have the opportunity to explore demos and enjoy special discounts on a wide selection of titles. In addition, we've dedicated a section on the event page to Girls Make Games, where you can learn more about their impactful work and discover the incredible games that girls have created through their program.


[i]By participating in The Indie Houses Steam Event, you're not only indulging in fantastic gaming experiences, but you're also contributing to a meaningful cause. A portion of the proceeds earned by each publisher during the event will be donated to the Girls Make Games Scholarship Fund. This fund combines professional development and financial support, ensuring that underrepresented students have early access to STEAM programs and the opportunity to thrive.

Girls Make Games has been providing an inclusive space for girls and non-binary students to explore the world of video games since 2014. Through their summer camps, workshops, and other initiatives, they have empowered over 23,000 girls in nearly 150 cities across 20 countries. To learn more about their inspiring mission, visit their website at [url=https://www.gmgsf.org]https://www.gmgsf.org[/url].

Don't miss out on this incredible event celebrating the talented women in gaming! Join us from May 25-31 on Steam, and let's make a difference together. Together, we're shaping a brighter and more inclusive future for the gaming industry.[/i]

notes.title: Jack Axe August Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]BRIDGES AND ENEMIES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/b6daaa8735e543161b247b5da1208c0fbf337a21.png[/img]

As we went near completion, we also took time to make our open areas more fun to explore. We’ve made some minor graphical changes on the bridges and trees on Freymont that we believe better fit the theme and looks more engaging in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/fefd40a5a60d315ebd3bc34bcf8cc0bfd9c29a6c.gif[/img]

We’ve also added Mini Yeti in the game that throws snowballs at a fixed angle.

[h1]SHOPS AND MINI-GAMES[/h1]

Challenges and levels sometimes get too hard in Jack Axe, so we’ve also added mini-games into the game so players can take a break from the main quest. Each mini-game will reward the players once a certain goal is reached.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FEMHvMF.gif[/img]
[b]Mini-game #1[/b]: Jester Star Ball Juggling

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/018c6173a09bf7406562cd93a696ecad3a33cf1b.png[/img]
[b]Mini-game #2[/b]: Jester’s Wheel of Treasures

We’ve also added in-game shops that let you personalize Jack in exchange of gold. These shops can be found in every level and offer’s varieties of tint dusts to choose from. Shopkeeper says that it's collected from fairy dust and some are pretty rare to find.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092017/f8cc7ac14198633640c54b6186f3b1eadd4d5037.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW LEVELS[/h1]

More fun and exciting level awaits you. From snow lands to a hot desert, you will also explore the mystic forest, sparkly beach to the flying ships up the skies.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6K7bKM5.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a8KCYWn.gif[/img]

[h1]MINOR CHANGES AND FIXES[/h1]

Compared to the previous demos, the current game plays differently now. We made sure that all of the players' feedback is taken into consideration.  From the characters movement to how the game will be played. We want to offer the best experience possible.

[u]Here are the list of changes we’ve made:[/u]

1. Game now supports multiple save slots
2. Added assist mode so players can play however they want or test difficult levels.
3. Bosses now drop triple rune instead of golden coin
4. Runes are now only stored in Fairy portals (previous versions has doors that requires rune to open)
5. Crasher traps should not be able to detect players when line of sight is blocked
6. Blue fish now kills player on contact
7. Changed turtle movement pattern
8. Red key should not be able to unlock all colored blocks
9. Golden scarab now automatically enchants axe with light that enable players to see in the dark.
10. Puzzle blocks can now be reset using reset targets
11. Some in game sounds now can only be heard depending on the source position. Meaning falls or a bullet sounds louder when it’s near.
12. Screenshakes now only plays when inside the camera
13. UI now has an additional text that displays how much gold you’ve gained and spent.
14. Runes are now displayed in numbers instead of icons. It makes the display cleaner and more unified.
15. A short text with an icon now appears when the game is being written and saved.

notes.title: 🪓The Temple and the Warrior
notes.notes:
[h1]The God Temple[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dn8iI8T.gif[/img]

Entry to The God Temple has been forbidden for as long as anyone can remember! Legend says that within the temple is a weapon so mighty that using it could change the world forever! But only the most powerful Warrior with the Truest Heart would be able to wield it and none have been deemed worthy!
In the past the unworthy have tried to seize the weapon and each time, calamity has been the response. As a result, the temple has been fortified with thick walls, brutal traps, and filled with dangerous creatures. The unworthy will never be allowed to take the weapon and use it for evil!

[h1]Jack[/h1]

Jack has always been a precocious child. She’s willful, quick witted, and tough as nails. The boys in the village have always found her intimidating and her father despaired at her lack of ladylike decorum. Jack never wanted to be the princess but dreamed of being the knight. Never wanted to be rescued but always wanted to be the hero. Craved adventure not domesticity.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4nKJNP5.gif[/img]

And now. As the wizard Ringles makes his plans to attack the God Temple, Jack’s greatest dreams and deepest fears are coming to fruition.
